title: ABBA Reasoning Assurance Substrate Compatibility Contract
rules: Phase 7 never creates a second canonical event table.
Phase 7 never calls a database write directly from the reasoning engine.
Phase 7 hands validated reasoning artifacts to the governed substrate binding layer.
The substrate binding layer must persist reasoning provenance before consequential execution.
The independent Authority + Policy + Consent Gate remains between reasoning and execution.
Existing production omnii event/state/execution primitives are adapted rather than duplicated.
